svg.text: Model passes only if ALL five gates clear in sequence

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why is OOS Sharpe 1.2 over 250 trades the right threshold and not higher or lower?')
sendPrompt('How do you calculate Cohen d and variance ratio in a live A/B/AZ trading partition?')
sendPrompt('What happens if a model cannot be tested in all five regime buckets due to data scarcity?')
g.text: OOS window must contain all five regime types at minimum coverage

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What triggers an immediate washout failure before the 30-day window completes?')
sendPrompt('What does a tail-risk sentinel trigger during a canary window mean for the promotion decision?')

g.text: All five gates clear → model promoted to full deployment
Any gate fails → model returned to walk-forward with diagnostics
